body.statement: Let \((K,S)\) be an \(r\)-dimensional Hermitian definite pencil with \(\|K\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le1\) and \(\|S^{-1}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le1\). If the ordered eigenvalues have gap \(\delta_k=\lambda_{k+1}-\lambda_k>0\), then for every \(\epsilon\in(0,1)\) there is a deterministic finite-precision algorithm returning a matrix \(\widetilde\Pi_k\) with \(\|\widetilde\Pi_k-\Pi_k\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\epsilon\), where \(\Pi_k\) projects onto the invariant subspace of the \(k\) smallest eigenvalues, using Boolean complexity polynomial in \(r\), \(\log(1/\delta_k)\), \(\log(1/\epsilon)\), and the logarithm of the condition number of \(S\).
